reviews.title: Great item for what it is made for just not what I was looking
reviews.comment: The item was as described. I just didn't realize that it required a custom Waterloop. Not the motherboard I needed
reviews.author: chris

reviews.title: Easy to install, have to download instructions.
reviews.comment: Pros: easy to install after downloading instructions Windows 11 booted up no issues Drivers where easy to install as well Looks real nice in case Comes with nifty extras The included wall paper is neat Custom Bios splash screen looks nice Cons: had to download instructions for the monoblock Cannot access the cpu header with monoblock installed Monoblock installs from rear of motherboard so how board must come out for a cpu swap One screw cannot be installed for holding in motherboard do to the monoblock being in the way
reviews.author: Logan H.

reviews.title: Great mother of scott
reviews.comment: Great for a first time water cooling build, ekwb makes it easy and fast to get up and running.
reviews.author: Kevin Eaton

reviews.title: Shines like a star!
reviews.comment: Top notch build quality, top notch specs, RGB works smoothly unlike gigabyte motherboards, and the most surprising thing was the audiophile grade audio output! As an audiophile I couldn't have been more happy with this purchase! Absolute beast of a motherboard.
reviews.author: Tanjimul Islam

reviews.title: Nice mobo
reviews.comment: Love this mobo. A bit older now but got it at a great price and good value with the included water block. No issue whatsoever with stability so far.
reviews.author: James Stoker
